description: Implementation of URLRequestJobFactory class managing protocol handlers and request jobs in the net namespace.

classes.name: HttpProtocolHandler
classes.description: Handles HTTP protocol requests, including WebSocket distinctions, as a subclass of URLRequestJobFactory::ProtocolHandler.

methods.name: CreateJob
methods.description: Creates a URLRequestJob based on the request, returning error jobs for invalid schemes.

methods.name: SetProtocolHandler
methods.description: Associates a scheme with a ProtocolHandler, or removes it if null.

methods.name: IsSafeRedirectTarget
methods.description: Determines if a URL is a safe redirect target based on protocol handler logic.

methods.name: SetInterceptorForTesting
methods.description: Sets a URLRequestInterceptor for testing purposes.
